topic: 1952 cabinet metadata divergence and late-year governance expansion

sources.title: 도의회 의원 총선거 실시에 관한 건

findings.claim: 상이군인 정양원 직제 metadata is internally divergent across NAK official surfaces
evidence: BA0084191 item/index and keyword index: 제104회, 1952-11-25
findings.rule: do not silently overwrite; retain both provenance layers until original document header and cabinet schedule are inspected

findings.claim: 대한병무협회 설립계획서 metadata is partly recoverable
evidence: compiled catalog unnumbered tail: 내무부, 39쪽, BA0084191
findings.rule: treat 제111회/1952-12-23 as archive-index metadata, not yet as confirmed deliberation/decision without schedule/original image

findings.claim: 국민학교 결식아동 급식대책 metadata is partly recoverable
evidence: compiled catalog unnumbered tail: 문교부, 8쪽, BA0084191
findings.rule: 제94회 is supported by item-level archive index but exact date and decision text remain open
separate plan drafting, cabinet placement, UNCACK/UNKRA consultation, and execution

findings.claim: late-1952 coal policy has multiple distinct actions
findings.rule: model as sub-events, not one flattened coal-policy event

findings.claim: 1952 local-election authorization can be separated from implementation
evidence: 대통령기록관: 2월15일 국무회의 의결, 5월10일 도의회 선거, 서울·경기·강원 제외
findings.rule: retain authorization, promulgation, actual polling and exclusions as separate actions
